info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Disputes-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Dispute Management API allows users to retrieve detailed information about payment disputes. This endpoint serves as a resource for payment processors and financial institutions needing to monitor and manage dispute cases effectively. By utilizing this API, developers can access a comprehensive list of disputes related to transactions, enabling quick resolution and analysis of payment issues. Ideal for businesses that handle large volumes of transactions, this API ensures transparency and operational efficiency in dispute resolution.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information regarding a specific payment dispute. Use this to access the status, details, and relevant metadata associated with the dispute.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve details about a payment dispute. The body must include the necessary identifiers and any relevant parameters needed to process the request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of payment dispute details.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to payments disputes. It is a string type that contains the relevant details or identifiers for querying disputes.
